text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Between her daily practice, social media 
activities, and preparations for the 
"Kawaii Derby♪" piling up—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan starts showing signs of 
overworking, worrying her Trainer and 
those around her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fueled by her Trainer's trust,
Curren Chan 
chooses the path of seeing things through 
to the very end on her own strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later.
Having safely overcome the critical 
moment,
she once again showed everyone her 
running with a smile.
